title: A shortlist is not a decision record

source.angle: Understand county-list review friction and preserve the reasons and open checks behind a shortlist.

intent.audience: People reviewing county parcel and tax-lien lists
intent.objective: Identify a concrete review-workflow problem for product discovery
intent.cta: Describe the most time-consuming part of county-list review

assistance.disclosure: In-development product framing from documented scoring, comparison, decision-history and checklist work.

claim_boundary: No public-launch, validated valuation, investment recommendation, legal conclusion, return guarantee or compliance-grade audit claim. No private dataset or credential is disclosed.
